headline: KRT sponsor group pledges 13.71% units
summary: Knowledge Realty Trust discloses pledge of 60.74 crore units (13.71%) by BREP entities to secure debt obligations under an amended facility agreement.

headline: Kirloskar Oil Engines secures TPG investment in Arka Fincap
summary: Kirloskar Oil Engines board approved a shareholders' agreement with TPG for a ₹525 crore initial investment in Arka Fincap, aiming to scale retail lending.
